_meta.description: Receives the MeetSum 'meeting.completed' webhook (payload v2), verifies the signature and adds a page to a Notion database (title, date, language, link, overview). For the full recap with action items and Hebrew RTL handling, prefer the built-in Notion integration (Settings → Integrations).
setup: 2. Configure your Notion API credential and share the target database with the integration
3. Set the database id, and make sure it has 'Date' (date), 'Language' (text) and 'MeetSum' (URL) properties, or remove them from the node

4. In MeetSum, Settings → Integrations → Webhooks (or POST /api/webhooks/subscriptions { url: '<webhook-url>', events: ['meeting.completed'], payloadVersion: 2 }): create a v2 subscription and copy the secret (shown once)

5. Set the n8n environment variable MEETSUM_WEBHOOK_SECRET to the subscription secret shown once by MeetSum (allow env access in Code nodes, or paste the secret into the 'Verify MeetSum signature' node).
